department: Search & Answer Intelligence (department 2): Lena, real-user page experience (Chrome UX Report field data)
basis: ADR 0050 (field data only; OFF by default; record-first reservations; per-run and daily call caps; provider:crux kill switch; the key only in the X-Goog-Api-Key header, never in a URL, log, error, status or report; no field data is INSUFFICIENT_FIELD_DATA, never fast or slow; the Core Web Vitals assessment passes only with LCP, INP and CLS all present and good; strict parsing; a null history point is no data; the trend is descriptive, never a forecast; tenant-scoped views). The war room's own oracle compares every reported value and rating with what the fake served for that exact key and web.dev's thresholds.

scenarios.persona: an origin or URLs Google has no field data for (its documented 404), for every form factor or only some, current data or history only
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 ('no field data' is INSUFFICIENT_FIELD_DATA, never fast, never slow; the history of a key with no current data is not asked)

scenarios.persona: records missing one metric (a Core Web Vital or not) for every key or only some form factors and kinds
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (the Core Web Vitals assessment passes only when LCP, INP and CLS are all present and good; otherwise not enough field data)

scenarios.persona: percentiles that are NaN, null, negative, mistyped, infinite or huge; histograms whose densities do not sum, are negative, have gaps, too many bins, an open middle bin; unknown fields inside a metric
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 / crux_client (strict parsing: a malformed metric is MALFORMED and dropped, never rated; the others are kept)

seeds.basis: the driver's metric mutations (BREAKING / UNCERTAIN), around the shapes pinned in tests/test_lena.py BAD_METRICS

scenarios.persona: History API series with null points (Google's 'no data that week'), "NaN" text, a short series, partial NaN densities, periods out of order or more than asked, all null
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (a period without data is null in p75s and "NaN" in densities; a null is never a value; the trend is descriptive, from periods with data only, never a forecast)

scenarios.persona: records keyed for the www twin, another tenant's origin, another form factor or a URL normalised onto another origin; inverted or missing periods; new top-level and record fields; unknown metrics; the retired FID served anyway; a period in the future or long past
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 / crux_client (the record's key must be the one asked; a normalised URL only on the same origin; unknown metrics ignored; FID never asked for and never reported)

seeds.basis: the driver's record-level mutations (RECORD_BREAKING / RECORD_UNCERTAIN / RECORD_PRESERVING), around tests/test_lena.py BAD_RECORDS

scenarios.persona: Google answering 400 / 401 / 403 / 418 / 429 (with and without Retry-After) / 5xx, timing out, refusing connections, redirecting, sending HTML, a huge or gzip or trickled body, echoing the key
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 / crux_client (closed reason codes; retries only on connect errors, timeouts, 429 and 5xx within the attempts and the deadline; a stopping code ends the read; the audit completes)

seeds.basis: storm scripts over the driver's steps (STORM_STEPS): one step per request, the last repeats

scenarios.persona: per-run and daily call caps (0 = OFF by default), the daily cap shared across tenants, the per-tenant daily cap, the www twin, a day passing, a restart
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (SEO_CRUX_CALLS_PER_RUN, SEO_CRUX_CALLS_PER_DAY across all tenants; record-first reservations; CRUX_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED when nothing is left). and SEO_CRUX_TENANT_CALLS_PER_DAY per tenant in any 24 hours

seeds.basis: cap settings named in ADR 0050 and config.py

scenarios.persona: Google's 150 queries per minute per project, enforced on the fake clock, against back-to-back audits at the per-run cap (the client paces itself, per process)
scenarios.basis: crux_client docstring (quota 150 queries per minute per project, shared by both APIs) and ADR 0050 (a 429 is CRUX_RATE_LIMITED and stops the read)

scenarios.persona: provider:crux, global, write, the tenant's and capability:audit engaged before or during a read; SEO_KILLED_PROVIDERS=crux; Lena restricted
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (provider:crux checked before the read, before every request and on every socket operation; the global, write, tenant and capability:audit switches as for every run step)

seeds.basis: the switches svc_crux.py and svc_audits.py check

scenarios.persona: the bare origin and its www twin, both registered (acme) or only the bare one (globex: the twin is asked too), with data for one, both or neither, and Google answering one with the other's record
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 limitations (CrUX keys are exact: https://example.com and https://www.example.com are different origins; an unregistered twin is asked and shown beside the audited origin, labelled, never merged)

scenarios.persona: another tenant, the hub with another tenant's token and Finance reaching for acme's page-experience section, or auditing acme's origin
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (the page-experience route is tenant-scoped: another tenant's audit is the same 404; Lena reads only a domain registered to the audit's tenant)

scenarios.persona: 25 URLs x 3 form factors x 2 APIs per audit at the per-run cap, and many audits across tenants against the daily cap
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 (queries in priority order until the run's call cap; NOT_QUERIED with the stopping code past it)

scenarios.persona: the API key pushed at every exit: Google's error bodies and messages, a redirect carrying it, exception messages, a record keyed with it, a metric named after it, the agent or the parser raising with it in the message
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 / svc_crux (the API key is never in a URL, a log line, an error, the status or the report)

scenarios.persona: SEO_CRUX_ENABLED=1 with the key file missing, empty, world-readable, a symlink, a directory, oversize, not a key, relative or unset; and the feature off with a bad file
scenarios.basis: ADR 0050 / config.py (enabled without a usable key file refuses start, under the *_FILE rules; no error quotes the file; disabled never reads it)

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: whole hostile CrUX answer plans from a grammar (grammar.crux_answer_plan): no-data keys, metric / record / history mutations by selector, paths, twins, caps
scenarios.basis: every MUST above, on inputs nobody listed; terminals from agents/lena.py THRESHOLDS and tests/crux_fakes.py BOUNDS

scenarios.persona: INVENTED by the war room: storms, caps, quotas, kills mid-read and tight deadlines from a grammar (grammar.crux_storm)
scenarios.basis: every MUST above, on storms nobody listed
